title: Foul Potion
description:
Deal [blue]12[/blue] damage to ALL players and enemies.
Can be thrown at the [gold]Merchant[/gold] for [blue]100[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] instead.
notes: Multi-context potion: In combat, damages all players and enemies. Outside combat at Merchants (Shop or Fake Merchant events), can be thrown for 100 gold instead.
